items.title: Burke Stevenson Interview, 1959-06-12
items.q: So when Chris Kelly came up to service, that's why I'd taken up music, I started, he taught me on trumpet.

ctx.x: Well, that was down for Jim Robinson and Sonny Henry.

That's right, that's right. And, uh, and also my boy, I always say I want to play music. And, uh, when I got in age around about, uh, 18, well I'd registered to go to the First World War, but I was too young, I was in that last draft, 18 to 45, and I just had made 19 years old. I got my card to go away on the 12th, and pieces clad on the 11th. So when Chris Kelly came up to service, that's why I'd taken up music, I started, he taught me on trumpet. And, uh, later, when I come in, it's getting better and better,…
Well, did we get on what instrument you started on?
